name: updateSessionStatus
shortDescription: Updates the status of an existing session (e.g., active, paused, ended) for a Molecule, controlled by a Lead Point.
description:
Overview

Modifies the status of an existing Session record, reflecting its lifecycle changes (e.g., from 'planned' to 'active', 'active' to 'paused', 'paused' to 'active', or 'active' to 'ended').

Intended use

Called by the Lead Point persona from the Session Control Panel UI to manage the progress of a session. Parameters include sessionId and newStatus.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the Session record using params.sessionId via ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  2. Verify that the ctx.user_id matches the idOfUser on the Session record, or that the user has the admin role. If not, return an unauthorized error.
  3. Validate params.newStatus against allowed Session.status enum values. If invalid, return an error.
  4. Update the Session record's status attribute using ctx.data.update.
  5. If newStatus is 'active', set startTime to the current timestamp if it's currently null. If newStatus is 'ended', set endTime to the current timestamp.
  6. Audit-log the session status update using ctx.audit.log, including the session ID and new status.
  7. Return the updated Session record.

Entities

  • Session
